Hi Hannah & Karthik,

Thanks again for hosting Alder Systems for the Immersion Day pilot on May 12. We're finalizing travel and wanted to confirm a couple quick things so we can lock the attendee list and travel windows: 

- Arrival window: our team lands at SFO ~9:30am. Is it OK to start the guest check-in at 10:30am?
- Conference room: which room will the demo be in (capacity for 18, AV notes)?
- NDAs: we need a quick link to sign NDAs for any on-site labs that require access.
- Parking / drop-off: any reserved spots for our shuttle?

I'll attach a tentative attendee roster this afternoon. If we need to shift the demo start earlier by 30–45 minutes we can accommodate but wanted to confirm your preferred start time.

Thanks,

Hi Paul — great to hear. 10:30am check-in works, and we can run the public-facing portion from 11:00am–1:00pm. A few quick notes / asks: 

- Room: we've reserved Conference Suite B (capacity 22). AV: dedicated HDMI + USB-C, presenter laptop + stage mic. I've attached the HQ floorplan so your driver can find the loading dock.
- NDA: I'll send a DocuSign link now for Alder attendees who will be in the labs. Please have the engineering visitors sign; security requires it prior to machine access.
- Parking: we can provide two short-term visitor hang-tags for loading; full-day parking passes take a lead time but we can arrange reserved spots if you give me the license plates by EOD Thursday.

If you need us to shift the demo start to 10:15am we can try to make that work, but it will compress setup and AV checks. Karthik / Marissa — looped you both for the run-of-show and badge pickup.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
